briefdescription.para: VQUEUE_PRIO_PRIORITY_RANGE configures the queue to accept priorities from [0:VQUEUE_PRIO_PRIORITY_RANGE-1]

detaileddescription.para: > Note: VQUEUE_PRIO_PRIORITY_RANGE must be power of two.
Initializes the tree of counters into an array.

Assume we have priority range of N=4 [0...3] We need (N*2 -1)=7 nodes for the tree The nodes reside into an array. e.g. this tree A / \ B C / \ / \ D E F G will be represented in an array as follows: A, B, C, D, E, F, G with indexes 0, ..., 7

> Note: only leaf nodes D, E, F, G hold references to stack bins and there the actual nodes associated with the priorities reside
